variables.description:
Global variables to supply to a given {@link App.Metric}.
Individual {@link App.Metric} can override these variables by specifying the overrides in
{@link App.Metric.QuerySpec}.
Notice that only values of strings are specified here, global variables for {@link App.Metric#APP_METER_DYNAMIC_REFERENCE meter_d}
and {@link App.Metric#APP_METRIC_DYNAMIC_REFERENCE metric_d} are intentionally not supported. Variable definitions for
these must be set in their respective {@link App.Metric.QuerySpec#variables} instead.

title: Represents global variables to set during {@link App.Metric} query evaluation from a {@link App.Metric.QuerySpec}.
name: App.Metric.WithGlobalVariables
